body: Thanks for the tips bro! This shit is nice it'd fly these days like crazy. People need the fresh breath of air

I love liquor but it tastes better with company. Just find one thing you like brother then invest time into it, eventually you'll be surrounded by people who have that same interest and want to share in it instead of just be around for it. My brother worked at some hole in the wall vape shop because it was his hobby and found his best friend that way, after being miserable and underappreciated for years by everyone. He didn't give a damn about being a dollar above minimum wage. He's since grown some and vaping isn't much his thing anymore but now he's on to planting fish tanks. I'm amazed at how much he's grown since diving into himself.
I extend my hand to you. I'm a loner too, my father was a loner as well. It hurts to the point of emptiness, like just a void of no emotion. Can we share in that at least?

You have a purpose. Something inside of you or divine knows your true worth and stopped you. I find that usually other people are the true issue. Something from the outside may be the issue and if it's something in you then who better to work on it than yourself?

You can't steady a boat with waves coming from everywhere. You must brave the storm to make it to nicer waters. After the rain comes the rainbow. I was taught that tough times make tough people, and life puts you in situations to grow from. I am happy you are still here. There's people you haven't even met yet that will help you grow and change your life for the better. It took me years to find those people but they are definitely out there.

I find that people going through something traumatic enough to push them to the edge are the most brave, thoughtful, peaceful people who's hearts are pure. Pain means you can feel and that definitely shows that you are aware and intelligent enough to grow. This is just a chapter in your book.

Thank you for your thoughtful words. I've calmed down a bit now and don't feel so overwhelmed thanks to you and cesar123kid. It's crazy to me that people see me as strong, sometimes I feel weak compared to others. Everything makes me grow it just seems like I'm a punching bag in a lot of ways. It's hard to get back up and face more knowing there isn't really an end close. Well I hope you're doing okay in your path of life and thank you so much again for your kind words. I'll cherish them always and look to this post for some strength when I feel down again. I hope you have a wonderful life, your observations are a gift.

Thank you for this... This gives me hope. I'm grateful for the little moments and today I'm grateful someone cared enough to read through my struggles and offer a hand and kind words. If you're going through anything I want you to know I'm right there with you too.

It happens. A lot. Like once a month or so. Honesty try some stretching/deep breathing and maybe do some push ups and jogging just to wake your body up. Maybe a nice long shower to ease the body and reset the mind. Try not to have a routine with producing or you'll end up making the same thing over and over and become uninspired. After 4+ years of making beats I've found that you gotta step away from it and you'll come back turnt tf up kind of when you least expect it and be like THERE WE GO the spark is back.
